turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Look at this example. I eat bread. He eats bread. Step 1: the person is "he". Step 2: so we add -s to "eat".
After he, she or it, add -s or -es to the verb.
Right: She reads books. Wrong: She read books every day.
Now you try. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
